photoPairs.guidance: Aktullagu piksa, tavra suli aktullagu ajjigikkaŋa.
photoPairs.intro: **Piksraqtagik 2-miñ 6-mun piksat** uumaniñ qaritauyamik. Qinnaniaqtut uvani makkaluŋmi kisian suli aullautitaunġitchut naagga ijiqsitaunġitchut allamun.

pictureBingo.guidance: Sivullikun titiqullugit makkalaurat. Tavra qinnallagu una tuqłuruaq aŋinirpaami qiniġviŋmi.

calmBreathing.guidance: Anertilaallaglutin ammaluktuam aglitilaaŋani, aneqaaġlutin mikłitilaaŋani. Taamna iŋmiñik nutqasiruq itchaksrat anertikpata.
calmBreathing.finished: Itchaksrat sukailluta anertiqsimaaqtugut. Aullaġniqsigik suli pisukkuvich.

storyChain.guidance: Tuqutiŋ kiŋuŋat: ataaniŋ uqaqtuaq ataaniŋ, aŋutiŋ kiŋuŋaq ilaqtuŋ.
storyChain.passNote: Uqaqtuaŋ uqaqtuaq ataqtuaq. Nalunaiqtuq uqaqtuaq tuqutiŋ. Kiŋuŋaq tuqutiŋŋa aglaŋŋa.
storyChain.fullAdd: Kiŋuŋat taamna tuqutiŋ. Ataqtuaq ilaŋŋat tuqutiŋ
storyChain.full: Kiŋuŋat tuqutiŋ 8 kiŋuŋaq tamaġa. Uqaqtuaq tamaġa tuqutiŋ, ataqtuaq ilaŋŋat tuqutiŋ ataqtuaq.
